description: One Shuttle-UM route with its stops in order (for the most common trip pattern on the given day) and the route polyline, from the published GTFS feed. No login needed.

date.description: Service date as YYYY-MM-DD (default: today in College Park)

route.description: Route id as in transportation_list_routes, e.g. "104" (event routes have longer ids)

name: transportation_get_route

color.description: Route colour as a six-digit hex string, e.g. "93c47d"

headsign.description: Destination shown on the bus for this pattern

long_name.description: Route name, e.g. "College Park Metro Station"

scheduled_today.description: true when at least one trip runs today

shape.description: Route polyline as [longitude, latitude] pairs, thinned to at most 500 points

short_name.description: Number or code shown on the bus, e.g. "104"

stops.description: Stops of the most common trip pattern, in order; empty when nothing is scheduled

sequence.description: Position along the route, starting at 0

timepoint.description: true for stops the timetable prints times for

wheelchair_boarding.description: Wheelchair access as the feed records it

url.description: DOTS page with the stop list and printed timetable

title: Get a Shuttle-UM route
